title: coast-raid-k Intelligence ingestion and knowledge governance schemas
description: Evidence-first interchange shapes for collecting public or authorized documents and proposing reviewed knowledge, including traceable public equipment measurements. This module contains no operational targeting, weapon control, or external execution fields.

provenance.description: Server-retained collection provenance. Source classification does not verify claims.

CapabilityMetricEvidence.description: Exact excerpt of an immutable sourceSnapshot body. Offsets count Unicode code points, use zero-based indexing, and define a half-open interval. Runtime validation must enforce 0 <= startChar < endChar <= len(body), body[startChar:endChar] == quote, matching source metadata, and the numeric value in this excerpt. Units, qualifiers and equipment/metric meaning require human review. JSON Schema alone cannot enforce these cross-field/source constraints.

CapabilityMetric.description: One traceable public equipment parameter, reported test result, maturity or supportability measure. It is a source-reported quantity, not a combat effectiveness score. Runtime validation must preserve the reported value, unit, qualifier, evidence basis and conditions; absent data is omitted and recorded as a gap, never imputed as zero.

value.description: Finite numeric quantity explicitly present in evidence.quote. Preserve the source magnitude and unit; no automatic unit conversion, percentage-to-ratio conversion, extrapolation or synthesized estimate.

basis.description: Evidence basis as reported by the source. Even reported-test is a reported result, not independent verification. Manufacturer claims and program targets must not be relabeled as demonstrated capability.

CapabilityAssessment.description: Optional additive analysis of source-reported public equipment measurements. It shares the report review gate and does not publish ontology assertions. No kill probabilities, battle outcome simulation, targeting, tactical optimization, real-time deployment tracking or overall combat power scoring.

basedOnAssessmentId.description: Present when this under-review report is derived from an existing assessment. The original report and its review/publication state remain unchanged.

provider.description: Provider that extracted the capability metrics, independently of the provider that produced the parent report's trend findings. Contains no credentials.

model.description: Model used for capability extraction, or null when no model applies. Does not replace the parent report's trend model metadata.

statistics.description: Recomputed from accepted metrics by the backend. metricCount equals metrics length; equipmentCount counts distinct equipment labels; citedSourceCount counts distinct evidence.itemId values, not independent publishers. The four basis counts sum to metricCount. These are coverage counts, not capability scores.

AssessmentValidation.description: Validation metadata for a report. Repeated model calls do not increase confidence unless an independent method, source set, adversarial check or human decision is recorded.

EvidenceGraphRevision.description: Immutable graph projection persisted for an assessment. It is an evidence view and does not publish trusted ontology assertions.

hash.description: Compatibility alias emitted by the normalized persistence projection. It equals contentHash.

oneOf.description: A versioned, evidence-linked graph snapshot for interactive exploration. Graph membership is a report projection and does not by itself assert trusted ontology facts.

OntologyAudit.description: Immutable periodic integrity result. It records evidence and review gaps; it never publishes a fact by itself.

OntologyAdmissionCandidate.description: An atomic, evidence-linked proposal for adding a capability or relation to the trusted ontology. It is never a published assertion until a human admission review creates a knowledge version.

OntologyAdmission.description: An immutable evidence-bound proposal for one capability observation, extracted entity/event or declared relation. Model proposals remain low/medium confidence; a graph candidate requires an explicit high-confidence human acceptance and a separate publication action. A graph-property candidate independently reviews one source-qualified descriptive attribute. Modification retires the proposal and creates a new immutable candidate; it does not accept it.

hash.description: Compatibility alias emitted by the normalized persistence projection.

AssessmentReportSections.description: The complete eight-part analyst report. The property is optional on AssessmentSummary for backward compatibility; when present it is a complete structured report and each section remains independently reviewable.

reviewAndOntology.description: Legacy combined view; new reports should use validationAndReview and ontologyAdmission separately.

capabilityAssessment.description: Optional for backward compatibility. Reports created before this extension remain valid without this property.

sections.description: Optional eight-part report structure. It is additive so existing assessments remain valid.

GraphAdmissionEvidence.description: Exact immutable source quote. Runtime enforces quote equality, full snapshot identity and locator boundaries; metadata classifies the publisher but does not verify the claim.

PublishedIntelligenceObject.description: Runtime query object from valid explicitly published admission records. Metadata and evidence envelopes are not themselves new ontology attributes. EventRecord is resolved to a declared event subtype before projection.
